newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends down on poor participation.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends down on poor participation.

text.p: Rubber prices in Malaysia finished softer as sentiment was again affected by a lack of strong participation and the weakness in Tokyo.
Dealers said there were not much business transacted as buyers continued to wait for cheaper levels.

"They (the buyers) waited again and I hoped the market would see fresh Far East interest as prices are rather cheap," a dealer at a trading firm said. "It was rather a slow moving day but there were some inquiries for SMR 20 from local dealers and Asian consumers."
Prices were mostly quoted few cents lower from last week, with trading houses quoting SMR CV at 326 cents, SMR L at 305, SMR5 at 268, SMR 20 at 256 and latex at 222.
"I believe the consumers are checking prices and not doing anything. They feel that the market could dip further due to uncertainty in Tokyo," another dealer said.

Latex demand also slackened except from some local gloves/condom makers' inquiries for nearby positions, dealers said. European consumers had mostly covered their positions ahead of the summer holidays, they said.
